question: Who among the following is NOT associated with Kathakali, a classical dance form of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Kelucharan Mohapatra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** is a renowned Indian classical dancer, but he is associated with **Odissi dance**, not Kathakali.
 
• He is considered one of the most prominent figures in reviving and popularizing the **Odissi dance form**, which is native to the Indian state of **Odisha**.
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra was honored with several prestigious awards, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, which is India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• His contributions to Indian classical dance and his role in establishing Odissi as a respected art form on a global level are widely recognized.
 
• While Kathakali is a classical dance form from **Kerala**, Kelucharan Mohapatra's work was focused on **Odissi dance and music**.
 
• Odissi is different from Kathakali, as it is characterized by its graceful movements, intricate footwork, and depiction of stories from **Hindu mythology**, particularly from the **Vaishnavite tradition**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kalamandalam Gopi**__

 __
 
• **Kalamandalam Gopi** is one of the most celebrated exponents of **Kathakali**, a classical dance-drama from Kerala.
 
• Kathakali is known for its elaborate costumes, makeup, and facial expressions to depict stories from **Indian epics** such as the Mahabharata and Ramayana.
 
• Kalamandalam Gopi has played iconic roles in Kathakali performances, earning him fame and recognition in the field.
 
• He was trained at the **Kalamandalam**, one of the premier institutions for Kathakali training.
 
 
 
• **Ramankutty Nair**__
 __
 
• **Ramankutty Nair** was another well-known artist associated with **Kathakali.**
 
• He was renowned for his performances in **traditional Kathakali roles**, particularly the heroic and anti-heroic characters.
 
• He contributed significantly to the preservation and promotion of Kathakali, ensuring its legacy continues in modern times.
 
 
 
• **Kalamandalam Rajan**__
 
 
• **Kalamandalam Rajan** is associated with **Kathakali** and is known for his expertise in this classical dance form.
 
• He trained and performed at the **Kalamandalam**, an institution dedicated to promoting Kerala’s traditional art forms.
